evidence.measurement_basis: Per-tick actual horizontal travel; a normal endpoint turn can cancel net displacement. Diagnostic preserved the original failed net-only acceptance and its 2.47m real walk.

scope: Actual production controllers, stationary-player passing and original-route rejoin, keeper/dog cohesion, explicit narrow-wall failure fixture, dynamic actor overlap and real menu/checkbox signals. No NPC placement or per-step teleport. Only scenario-start player placements and removable test walls. Local passing is game authored, not a validated global crowd model, measured walking behaviour, native human control, performance or other-Mac acceptance.
